data.description: 虚幻引擎是 Epic Games 开发的实时 3D 创作工具，用于游戏、影视和可视化。Unreal Engine 4 和 Unreal Engine 5 是不同的主要版本；UE5 引入了 Nanite 虚拟化几何体和 Lumen 动态全局光照。Android 库文件名（如 libUE4.so 或 libUnreal.so）本身不能验证应用使用的引擎版本，也不能证明应用启用了某项渲染功能。
data.label: Unreal Engine

data.description: Unreal Engine is Epic Games’ real-time 3D creation tool for games, film and visualization. Unreal Engine 4 and Unreal Engine 5 are distinct major versions; UE5 introduced Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen dynamic global illumination. An Android library filename (such as libUE4.so or libUnreal.so) alone does not verify the engine version used by an app or establish that a rendering feature is enabled.
data.label: Unreal Engine
